meta.note: One-line descriptions of dishes on the sample menus. Sources are listed in docs/research-notes.md.

dishes.name: Rajma
dishes.description: Red kidney beans cooked in a spiced onion and tomato gravy, usually eaten with rice.

dishes.name: Jeera rice
dishes.description: Rice cooked with cumin seeds (jeera).

dishes.name: Roti
dishes.description: Round, unleavened whole-wheat flatbread cooked on a flat griddle.

dishes.name: Kachumber
dishes.description: A fresh chopped salad of tomato, cucumber and onion with lemon juice.

dishes.name: Aloo gobi
dishes.description: Potatoes (aloo) and cauliflower (gobi) cooked with turmeric and spices.

dishes.name: Dal makhani
dishes.description: Whole black lentils slow-cooked into a creamy, buttery dal.

dishes.name: Raita
dishes.description: Cool, seasoned yogurt, often mixed with cucumber or onion; served on the side.

dishes.name: Chole
dishes.description: Chickpeas cooked in a spiced tomato and onion gravy; also called chana masala.

dishes.name: Kadhi pakora
dishes.description: A tangy yogurt and gram-flour curry with soft gram-flour fritters (pakoras) in it.

dishes.name: Kadhi
dishes.description: A tangy curry of yogurt or buttermilk thickened with gram flour.

dishes.name: Aloo matar
dishes.description: Potatoes and green peas in a mildly spiced tomato gravy.

dishes.name: Palak paneer
dishes.description: Cubes of paneer cheese in a smooth, spiced spinach (palak) sauce.

dishes.name: Aloo methi
dishes.description: Potatoes sauteed with chopped fresh fenugreek (methi) leaves.

dishes.name: Gobi matar
dishes.description: Cauliflower and green peas cooked in a light tomato sauce.

dishes.name: Kheer
dishes.description: Rice pudding slow-cooked in milk with sugar and dried fruit.

dishes.name: Butter chicken
dishes.description: Chicken in a mild, creamy tomato and butter sauce; murgh makhani.

dishes.name: Dal tadka
dishes.description: Yellow dal finished with a tadka: spices sizzled in hot ghee or oil and poured over.

dishes.name: Paneer butter masala
dishes.description: Soft cubes of paneer cheese in a rich, creamy tomato and butter gravy.

dishes.name: Pulao
dishes.description: Rice cooked in stock with whole spices, often with peas, chickpeas or meat.

dishes.name: Khichdi
dishes.description: Rice and lentils cooked together into a soft, comforting one-pot meal.

dishes.name: Pav bhaji
dishes.description: A thick, buttery mashed-vegetable curry (bhaji) eaten with soft bread rolls (pav).

dishes.name: Dal
dishes.description: Split lentils, peas or beans cooked into a soup or stew; eaten daily across South Asia.

dishes.name: Chana dal
dishes.description: Split, skinned black chickpeas cooked into a thick, nutty dal.

dishes.name: Moong dal
dishes.description: Split mung beans cooked into a light, quick dal.

dishes.name: Masoor dal
dishes.description: Split red lentils cooked soft; musur dal in Bengali.

dishes.name: Toor dal
dishes.description: Split yellow pigeon peas, the everyday dal of Gujarat and much of India.

dishes.name: Sev tameta shaak
dishes.description: A tomato curry topped with crunchy gram-flour noodles (sev).

dishes.name: Shaak
dishes.description: The Gujarati word for a cooked vegetable dish.

dishes.name: Bhinda shaak
dishes.description: Okra (bhinda) cooked Gujarati-style with light spices.

dishes.name: Batata shaak
dishes.description: A simple Gujarati potato (batata) curry.

dishes.name: Rotli
dishes.description: Thin Gujarati whole-wheat flatbread, the everyday bread of a Gujarati thali.

dishes.name: Undhiyu
dishes.description: A mixed-vegetable casserole from Gujarat, traditionally slow-cooked in winter.

dishes.name: Gujarati kadhi
dishes.description: A thin, gently sweet curry of buttermilk and gram flour, the Gujarati style of kadhi.

dishes.name: Chaas
dishes.description: A cool, thin drink of yogurt whisked with water and spices.

dishes.name: Ringan bateta
dishes.description: Aubergine (ringan) and potato (bateta) cooked together Gujarati-style.

dishes.name: Thepla
dishes.description: Soft Gujarati flatbread made from spiced flours, often with fenugreek leaves.

dishes.name: Dal dhokli
dishes.description: Pieces of spiced wheat-flour dough simmered in toor dal.

dishes.name: Shrikhand
dishes.description: A sweet made from strained yogurt with sugar, cardamom and saffron.

dishes.name: Dudhi
dishes.description: Bottle gourd, a mild green vegetable.

dishes.name: Khaman dhokla
dishes.description: A soft, spongy, steamed savoury cake from Gujarat.

dishes.name: Puri
dishes.description: Small rounds of whole-wheat dough deep-fried until they puff up; a bread found across South Asia, including Gujarati thalis.

dishes.name: Chhundo
dishes.description: A sweet and spicy Gujarati relish of grated raw mango.

dishes.name: Handvo
dishes.description: A savoury Gujarati cake of rice and lentil batter with vegetables.

dishes.name: Chutney
dishes.description: A fresh relish or dip, here ground from herbs, coconut or tomato with spices.

dishes.name: Papad
dishes.description: A thin, crisp disc of dried lentil dough, roasted or fried.

dishes.name: Aloo gosht
dishes.description: Meat (gosht) and potatoes (aloo) cooked together in a spiced curry.

dishes.name: Karahi
dishes.description: Meat cooked quickly with tomato, ginger and green chilli in a wok-like karahi pan.

dishes.name: Keema
dishes.description: Minced meat cooked with onion, tomato and spices, often with peas or potato.

dishes.name: Haleem
dishes.description: A slow-cooked stew of meat, wheat and lentils, stirred until thick and smooth.

dishes.name: Naan
dishes.description: Soft, leavened flatbread baked in a very hot tandoor oven.

dishes.name: Biryani
dishes.description: Layered rice and spiced meat or vegetables, sealed and slow-cooked together.

dishes.name: Shami kebab
dishes.description: A pan-fried patty of minced meat and lentils, ground together with spices.

dishes.name: Nihari
dishes.description: Beef or lamb shank slow-cooked into a rich, spiced stew.

dishes.name: Daal chawal
dishes.description: Dal served over plain rice (chawal), a favourite comfort meal.

dishes.name: Achar
dishes.description: A South Asian pickle of fruit or vegetables preserved with spices, oil or salt.

dishes.name: Korma
dishes.description: Meat or vegetables braised slowly with yogurt and spices into a thick sauce.

dishes.name: Mirchi ka salan
dishes.description: Hyderabadi chilli and peanut curry, served with biryani.

dishes.name: Bagara baingan
dishes.description: Small aubergines in a rich Hyderabadi gravy, a classic side for rice.

dishes.name: Khatti dal
dishes.description: Hyderabadi sour dal, soured with tamarind and eaten with rice and pickle.

dishes.name: Dalcha
dishes.description: A Hyderabadi lentil stew, often cooked with meat and soured with tamarind.

dishes.name: Bagara rice
dishes.description: Hyderabadi rice cooked with whole spices; bagara khana, often served with dalcha.

dishes.name: Double ka meetha
dishes.description: A Hyderabadi bread pudding topped with dried fruit.

dishes.name: Sambar
dishes.description: A lentil stew cooked with vegetables and tamarind.

dishes.name: Poriyal
dishes.description: A dry side dish of one or more stir-fried vegetables, eaten with rice.

dishes.name: Lemon rice
dishes.description: Rice tossed with lemon juice, turmeric, mustard seeds, peanuts and curry leaves.

dishes.name: Rasam
dishes.description: A thin, spicy and sour soup, usually made with tamarind, eaten with rice.

dishes.name: Bisi bele bath
dishes.description: A hot Karnataka rice dish cooked with lentils and vegetables.

dishes.name: Tamarind rice
dishes.description: Rice mixed with a tangy tamarind, spice and peanut paste; puliyodarai in Tamil.

dishes.name: Kootu
dishes.description: Vegetables and lentils cooked together into a thick, mild stew.

dishes.name: Curd rice
dishes.description: Rice mixed with yogurt and tempered with mustard seeds and curry leaves.

dishes.name: Idli
dishes.description: Soft steamed cakes of fermented rice and lentil batter.

dishes.name: Vada
dishes.description: A savoury black-lentil fritter shaped like a doughnut, crisp outside and soft inside.

dishes.name: Avial
dishes.description: A Kerala dish of mixed vegetables in a coconut and yogurt sauce.

dishes.name: Masala dosa
dishes.description: A thin, crisp fermented rice and lentil crepe filled with spiced potato.

dishes.name: Ven pongal
dishes.description: Rice and mung dal cooked soft with ghee, black pepper and cumin.

dishes.name: Matta rice
dishes.description: Kerala red rice, a nutty parboiled rice with a red outer layer.

dishes.name: Thoran
dishes.description: Kerala stir-fried chopped vegetables with grated coconut.

dishes.name: Appam
dishes.description: A lacy Kerala pancake of fermented rice batter, soft in the middle.

dishes.name: Ishtu
dishes.description: A mild Kerala stew of vegetables or meat in coconut milk, often eaten with appam.

dishes.name: Chettinad
dishes.description: A Tamil regional style known for bold, peppery spice blends.

dishes.name: Parotta
dishes.description: A flaky, layered flatbread made from flour and oil.

dishes.name: Payasam
dishes.description: A South Indian sweet pudding of rice cooked in milk.

dishes.name: Macher jhol
dishes.description: A traditional, lightly spiced Bengali fish curry.

dishes.name: Shorshe ilish
dishes.description: Hilsa fish cooked in a sharp mustard (shorshe) sauce, a Bengali classic.

dishes.name: Shukto
dishes.description: A mildly bitter Bengali mixed-vegetable dish, traditionally eaten first in a meal.

dishes.name: Kosha mangsho
dishes.description: Bengali mutton curry, slow-cooked with onion and spices until thick and dark.

dishes.name: Luchi
dishes.description: A small, puffy deep-fried bread made with white flour; a Bengali favourite.

dishes.name: Mishti doi
dishes.description: Sweet Bengali yogurt, set with sugar or jaggery.

dishes.name: Bhorta
dishes.description: Mashed vegetables, such as potato or roasted aubergine, mixed with mustard oil and chilli.

dishes.name: Rezala
dishes.description: Meat in a thin, fragrant gravy of yogurt and cardamom.

dishes.name: Polao
dishes.description: Fragrant rice cooked with ghee and whole spices, the Bengali pilaf.

dishes.name: Shak bhaji
dishes.description: Leafy greens (shak) stir-fried with garlic and chilli.

dishes.name: Bhuna khichuri
dishes.description: Rice and lentils cooked together with spices; bhuna means fried until rich, giving a drier, pilaf-like texture.

dishes.name: Borhani
dishes.description: A spiced yogurt drink from Bangladesh, served with rich rice dishes.

dishes.name: Qabuli palaw
dishes.description: Afghanistan's national dish: rice cooked in meat stock, topped with carrots and raisins.

dishes.name: Salata
dishes.description: Afghan salad of tomato and onion, often with cucumber.

dishes.name: Bolani
dishes.description: Thin flatbread stuffed with potato, leek or pumpkin, then pan-fried.

dishes.name: Kofta
dishes.description: Spiced meatballs, usually of ground beef, cooked in a sauce.

dishes.name: Challow
dishes.description: Afghan white rice cooked with mild spices so the grains stay separate.

dishes.name: Sabzi
dishes.description: Greens; in Afghan cooking, spinach and herbs slow-cooked with spices.

dishes.name: Mantu
dishes.description: Steamed dumplings filled with onion and ground beef, topped with garlic yogurt and a tomato-lentil sauce.

dishes.name: Aushak
dishes.description: Dumplings filled mainly with leeks, topped with yogurt, mint and often a meat sauce.

dishes.name: Shorwa
dishes.description: A simple Afghan soup of meat and vegetables.

dishes.name: Dal bhat
dishes.description: Nepal's everyday meal: steamed rice (bhat) with lentil soup (dal), vegetables and pickle.

dishes.name: Aloo tama
dishes.description: A tangy Nepali curry of potato, fermented bamboo shoot (tama) and black-eyed beans.

dishes.name: Gundruk
dishes.description: Fermented, dried mustard greens from Nepal, made into a tangy pickle or soup.

dishes.name: Momo
dishes.description: Himalayan dumplings filled with minced meat or vegetables, served with a tomato dip.

dishes.name: Kwati
dishes.description: A Nepali soup made from nine kinds of sprouted beans, traditionally eaten at the Janai Purnima festival.

dishes.name: Saag
dishes.description: Leafy greens, such as mustard greens or spinach, cooked simply with spices.

dishes.name: Thukpa
dishes.description: A warming Himalayan noodle soup with vegetables, and often meat or chicken.

dishes.name: Parippu
dishes.description: The Tamil and Malayalam word for dal: split lentils cooked soft and seasoned.

dishes.name: Pol sambol
dishes.description: Freshly grated coconut ground with chilli, onion and lime.

dishes.name: Kottu roti
dishes.description: Shredded flatbread stir-fried on a griddle with vegetables, egg or meat and spices.

dishes.name: Gotu kola sambol
dishes.description: A fresh salad of finely shredded gotu kola leaves with coconut and lime, traditionally with dried Maldive fish flakes.

dishes.name: String hoppers
dishes.description: Nests of thin steamed rice-flour noodles (idiyappam), eaten with curries.

dishes.name: Kiri hodi
dishes.description: A mild, fragrant Sri Lankan coconut-milk gravy.

dishes.name: Yellow rice
dishes.description: Rice cooked with turmeric and spices; kaha bath in Sinhala.

dishes.name: Adobo
dishes.description: Meat braised in vinegar, soy sauce, garlic, bay leaves and black pepper.

dishes.name: Garlic rice
dishes.description: Rice fried with plenty of garlic; sinangag in Filipino.

dishes.name: Atchara
dishes.description: A Filipino pickle of grated unripe papaya with carrot and ginger in vinegar.

dishes.name: Sinigang
dishes.description: A sour Filipino soup, usually soured with tamarind, with meat and vegetables.

dishes.name: Pancit bihon
dishes.description: Very thin rice noodles stir-fried with soy sauce, vegetables and meat.

dishes.name: Lumpia shanghai
dishes.description: Thin, crisp fried spring rolls filled with seasoned minced meat.

dishes.name: Tinola
dishes.description: Chicken soup simmered with ginger, green papaya and leafy greens.

dishes.name: Menudo
dishes.description: Filipino pork-and-liver stew with tomato sauce, potato and carrot; unrelated to the Mexican tripe soup of the same name.

dishes.name: Turon
dishes.description: Sliced banana wrapped in a spring-roll wrapper with brown sugar and fried.
